art_direction: Luxury Tech Dark Mode (Archetype 4 & 5 hybrid) - High-contrast, cinematic, and authoritative.

rules.H1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] tracking-tighter leading-[1.05] font-medium

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetric bento grids. Never fill 100% perfectly. Leave breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strictly left-aligned for dense content. Never center-align paragraphs.

components.name: Background Paths Hero
components.instruction: Full screen (min-h-screen) with absolute positioned animated SVG paths (using framer-motion pathLength). Masked line-by-line reveal for 'Atharvi Desurkar'. The hero should feel incredibly cinematic with massive negative space.

components.name: Spotlight Glow Card
components.instruction: React component for the Projects grid. Tracks pointer position to render a radial gradient glow (accent color with low opacity) behind a 1px border. Background should be `surface`. Must feel tactile.

components.name: Numbered Manifesto (About Section)
components.instruction: Large overlapping numbers (e.g., '01', '02') using `text-[12rem] text-white/5` absolute positioned behind the text to create tension and structural art.

components.name: Editorial Marquee
components.instruction: Slow, smooth moving text band. Use JetBrains Mono, highly spaced (gap-32), text-[#94A3B8] mixed with outline text. Engine: react-fast-marquee or framer-motion.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll (momentum scrolling) is MANDATORY.
motion.reveals: Framer motion for staggered section reveals. Elements should fade in and translate-y slightly (20px).
motion.microinteractions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Focus states must be distinct.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the portfolio using React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion (.js/.jsx files).
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling at the root level.
Use the exact color palette and typography rules specified. DO NOT use pink or purple.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Formspree contact form should use custom Tailwind styles to match the high-end dark theme (no Vercel-look default styles).
The Background Paths hero must use absolute positioning behind the main hero text, scaling up on load.
Spotlight Glow cards must be used for the Projects grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 layout with Spotlight Glow wrapping each project item.
Omit CGPA and academic grade details as requested, but include all other experience/skills.
Include specific sections: About, Skills, Projects (9 items), Research & Experience, Certifications, Beyond Tech, and Contact.
universal_guidelines: No generic centered layouts (use left-alignment or optical alignment).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-xl (12-24px blur) for sticky nav. Ensure readable text contrast.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.
Add micro-animations for hover, focus, and entrance.
Do not use generic simple gradients; use subtle noise overlays or solid deep colors.
